title: Reports of Insect or Mosquito Bites in Project Wolbachia Areas
what_it_is: Reports of Insect or Mosquito Bites in Project Wolbachia Areas

sections.label: Wolbachia mosquito release effects
sections.summary: Released male mosquitoes do not bite, and wild-type Aedes aegypti populations fall by up to 98%, reducing dengue cases by up to 70%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: While the male mosquitoes released do not bite, their increased presence can be noticeable to residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The increase in feedback is however temporary as residents become accustomed to the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA's data shows that after a few months of releases, the population of the wild-type Aedes aegypti mosquito falls to very low levels, decreasing by up to 98%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Bites from these mosquitoes are correspondingly significantly reduced.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This is evident in the reduction of dengue cases by up to 70% observed in study sites with at least one year of releases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: However, as Wolbachia-Aedes technology does not affect other species of mosquitoes, residents may still experience some bites from such mosquitoes.

sections.label: Punggol release resident notification
sections.summary: Before the 30 August release, NEA distributed letters, banners, posters and emails, and will explore more targeted direct engagement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Specific to the Punggol site, prior to release on 30 August, there was door-to-door distribution of letters to residents and establishments at HDB blocks, display of banners, posters at lift lobbies, to inform residents of the release schedule as well as emails to schools, childcare centres and condominiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We take the Member's feedback that, on top of these channels, we should explore more targeted, direct engagement, including door-to-door, so that this will increase the community's awareness, understanding, buy-in and support of the Project Wolbachia.

sections.label: NEA community outreach programmes
sections.summary: NEA works with the community and grassroots to carry out these outreach programmes, as with all Government initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: NEA works with the community and grassroots to carry out these outreach programmes, as with all the various Government initiatives.
